evidenceLimits: Annual snapshots miss intermediate movement, retargeting, and within-year qi exposure; endpoint travel is a lower-bound chord sum, not route length.
Current target and local feasible-neighborhood qi only support a claim about local target bias; they do not imply global attraction, monotonic convergence, or whole-map pathfinding.
Exact qi==1 share is reported explicitly because saturation can hide variation among high qi cells.

sampling.entityScope: all mortal world.entities with finite id/x/y
sampling.occupancyMeaning: entity observations per sample (density/presence); not movement
sampling.movedArrivalMeaning: matched entity changed position; endpoint cell only, no path reconstruction
sampling.localTransitionMeaning: matched move <= 8 world tiles and <= 1 grid-cell delta per axis; count destination cell and edge only
sampling.skippedMovement: far and multi-cell moves are excluded from local flow; never interpolated
sampling.anchorPairRule: For moved endpoints only, record nearest village/site/leyline pair when both are within 20 world tiles; anchor snapshot at sampling time.

purity.assertion: At each 50-year boundary, serializeWorld SHA-256 plus territory-array SHA and advanceState SHA are unchanged by a discarded readSample call.

summary.judgement: Local transition hotspots repeat moderately across adjacent 50-year epochs (mean top-24 Jaccard 0.524), but their per-cell counts correlate strongly with occupancy (mean Pearson 0.890) and 64% of the top-24 cells overlap on average. This is evidence for persistent population/activity concentrations, not independent road corridors.
summary.runtimeRoadRecommendation: defer; cell-level traffic largely co-locates with occupancy, origin/destination proximity counts do not prove route geometry, and no sample interval reconstructs a path.

evidencePolicy.fullMatrices: ignored local reports / Actions Artifact only
evidencePolicy.runtimePackage: compact summary; no golden, proof, research, source art or logs
